scope: Full tracked checkout; targeted static source and selected assertion-body review of issue model, CLI inventory, create/ready/claim/reclaim/update/close/epic paths, shared workflow and capacity transaction admission, optional MCP mutations, local database authority, selected JSONL export/import boundaries, inherited context, audit and reopen. Not every-line, full engine/migration/repair/merge/publication-primitive/installer/runtime certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Validated issue and initial workflow/capacity admission; related records, graph checks and mutation audit inside storage transaction; selected CLI relation preparation traced
lifecycle_review.select: Readiness handles stale cache by in-memory graph query; start/close hierarchy rollups differ intentionally; scheduler ranks ready candidates and returns advice without worker dispatch
lifecycle_review.claim: CLI --claim populates expected-unassigned/actor, storage checks state and observed tuple CAS; same-actor allowed unless exclusive; ordinary assignment and MCP fields do not require claim guard
lifecycle_review.progress: Scalar/label atomic batches with optional issue timestamp precondition; notes/context/comments retained; MCP optional comment is separate mutation; no required worker-attempt credential
lifecycle_review.review: Opt-in policy, required fields and scoped gate history; providers caller asserted, status-event revision distinct from content/artifact revision; typed references syntactic
lifecycle_review.complete: CLI and MCP close check blockers/children and close policy before common workflow/capacity transaction; generic storage close update omits CLI-specific evaluator; force versus audited policy bypass distinct; policy metadata enrichment can follow commit
lifecycle_review.cancel: Reopen and explicit task-state changes preserve shared record; no inspected worker launcher/canceller or external effect compensation
lifecycle_review.recover: Stale heuristics from issue time and external mail/agent snapshots; explicit owner/revision guarded transfer and audit in same transaction; local lock/transaction retry and conditional JSONL publication; DB versus file commit gap and MCP committed-error reporting; separate clones lack shared exclusive claims
